DIAGNOSIS READY: Multiple cutaneous squamous cell carcinomas (penile and digital).

REQUEST IMAGES: Dermoscopy of penile and finger lesions.
REQUEST TEST: Excisional biopsy of the most suspicious lesion.

The patient mentioned a history of unsuccessful syphilis and eczema treatments, so we must rule out secondary syphilis, but the non-healing, crusty nature on high-risk sites is highly concerning for malignancy. Please confirm if you have had any sun exposure or chronic skin ulcers in the past.
